ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.25; the majority of the surface area is low-intensity black with two significant high-intensity white regions localized on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-contrast contiguous white blobs: the left lobe contains a roughly rectangular white region centered on the lateral axis; the right lobe contains a similar but more elongated white region extending toward the distal tip. The central region surrounding the notch is a solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A distinct V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible along the entire trailing edge, appearing as a jagged linear boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a moderate concave curve from the median notch toward the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular high-intensity pixel clusters are visible along the upper margin of the right lobe's black pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible within the white pigmentation area of the left lobe, oriented roughly horizontally.

other_distinctive_markers: Symmetric isolation of white pigmentation to the outer lateral regions of the fluke lobes, creating a distinct 'wing-tip' appearance.
